title: Review-output paging reports offsetBytes/totalBytes in characters, not UTF-8 bytes
outcome: The review-output paging fields named in bytes are in UTF-8 bytes, or are renamed to say what unit they use, so a strict reader's offsets match the text it receives.
acceptance: A note identifies, with file and line, where the review-output offsetBytes and totalBytes are computed and which unit is used; it links any existing review-output item that already covers this, and if one does, this item is superseded into it.
The fields and their consumers use one documented unit, with a deterministic test using non-ASCII text where character and byte counts differ; no text is lost or duplicated across pages.
The independent review pair finds no Medium or higher, and the full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
